caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone is secretly scanning your face with invisible light – and for a brilliant reason!

Here’s how this mind-blowing tech works:
🔹 A tiny infrared (IR) LED next to your front camera emits invisible light.
🔹 When this light bounces back from your ear or pocket, your phone instantly knows you're close.
🔹 This clever detection turns off your display, saving battery and preventing those dreaded "pocket dials" or accidental touches!
